SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS  wp_posts.*
					 FROM wp_posts  LEFT JOIN wp_term_relationships ON (wp_posts.ID = wp_term_relationships.object_id) LEFT JOIN wp_posts AS p2 ON (wp_posts.post_parent = p2.ID) 
					 WHERE 1=1  AND wp_posts.ID IN (12699,12702,12706,12709,12711,12715,12718,12721,12724,12727,12730,12733,12735,12740,12743,12746,12748,12751,12754,12757,12761,12764,12767,12770,12773,12775,12779,12783,12786,12789,12793,12797,12799,12802,12806,12809,12813,12816,12819,12825,12829,12832,12837,12841,12845,12849) AND ( 
  wp_posts.ID NOT IN (
				SELECT object_id
				FROM wp_term_relationships
				WHERE term_taxonomy_id IN (7,9)
			) 
  AND 
  wp_term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN (382)
) AND wp_posts.post_author NOT IN (4508,4509)  AND wp_posts.post_type = 'product' AND (((wp_posts.post_status = 'publish') OR (wp_posts.post_status = 'inherit' AND (p2.post_status = 'publish')))) AND wp_posts.post_status = 'publish' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wp_term_relationships emo_vis_tr INNER JOIN wp_term_taxonomy emo_vis_tt ON emo_vis_tt.term_taxonomy_id = emo_vis_tr.term_taxonomy_id WHERE emo_vis_tr.object_id = wp_posts.ID AND emo_vis_tt.taxonomy = 'product_visibility' AND emo_vis_tt.term_id IN (7,9)) AND wp_posts.post_author NOT IN (4508,4509)
					 GROUP BY wp_posts.ID
					 ORDER BY FIELD(wp_posts.ID,12825,12829,12746,12724,12841,12799,12809,12797,12793,12751,12711,12702,12706,12783,12779,12789,12757,12715,12718,12735,12740,12802,12709,12748,12770,12733,12775,12816,12727,12767,12837,12813,12773,12721,12819,12743,12699,12730,12806,12849,12832,12786,12845,12764,12761,12754)
					 LIMIT 0, 15
